about_the_game:
A dating sim rhythm game where you seduce serial killers!

FUNDED ON KICKSTARTER


After waking in a mysterious house, you find yourself stuck with a group of strangers, all as confused as you are. Together you try to reveal the mysteries of the house, and what brought you all there. If only they weren't so stupid.



The narrative of Serial Lover is presented in a visual novel format with many player choices for additional dialogue. As you progress through phases of the game, you can choose a killer to pursue, but are challenged with a rhythm game you must complete to seduce your killer!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature themes, including suggestive content, implied nudity and sexual acts, strong language, blood and violence, descriptions of cannibalism and bodily mutilation, sexual violence, depictions of suicide, death and murder, stylized portrayals of mental health conditions, BDSM elements, and dark or disturbing subject matter, including PTSD and bullying.
